recommendations.title: Extend LLM-DEBUG-001 to OTEL tool-level logging leaks
recommendations.description: LLM-DEBUG-001 only detected OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES. v2.1.157 surfaces tool_parameters into tool_decision telemetry events when OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Added detection for OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 (leak tool parameters: command lines, file paths, secrets; and tool results: file contents, command output). Title/description/remediation broadened; +8 patterns, +3 negative patterns. Dual-use note added: Sentinel's own perf-tracing guidance uses OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in a local/ephemeral context only.

impact.description: Closes a real detection gap in tool-parameter/result telemetry leakage (CWE-532, OWASP-LLM02/06:2025).
